description: Bradford council street parking fines is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council. Data shows the total monthly and annual income received for parking PCNs (penalty charge notices) for both on street and off street (car park) contraventions. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
